name: Wall dash: a diagonal dash from a cling keeps x at 1
techNote: A wall (x -140 to -100) over a metal floor. Clinging to its right face, dash up-right: a dash from a wall cling goes away from the wall with dashDirection.x set to 1 after the normalize, so it moves at (1670, 1181) u/s instead of the diagonal's (1181, 1181): 33.4 u a tick across. It is at x 272.9 at the dash's end (tick 13) and in the finish box (x 270-330, y 460-540) on tick 14; a diagonal dash from the same point off the wall is at x 185 then.
